dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute triangular vertex with a near-zero pixel radius, forming a sharp point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-curvature, elongated convex slope transitioning into a flat anterior plane.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 165 degrees at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Artificial low-polygon geometric structure with high-saturation cyan/teal emissive texture mapping and distinct aliasing on silhouettes.
